themes.name: Wishy 2-Bit
themes.author: Wishy Launcher contributors
themes.description: Pure black and white, one fat pixel font and nothing else: your apps as a plain text menu with a blinking arrow, like the start screen of an old handheld game.

themes.name: Wishy Grid
themes.author: Wishy Launcher contributors
themes.description: A different layout from the same engine: sections down the left, every app in a grid on the right, the clock on the left and the status icons drawn by the theme. Shows what a theme can restructure.

themes.name: Wishy Home
themes.author: Wishy Launcher contributors
themes.description: The default look. Flat, calm and readable from the sofa: the same colours as Settings, one row of wide banner tiles, the name of the selected app, and a clock. Every Display setting applies (corners, size, spacing, labels, accent, wallpaper, clock, date, status bar, sections, app order).

themes.name: Wishy Wheel
themes.author: Wishy Launcher contributors
themes.description: A ring of round app icons on the left where only the middle one is selected. Press up or down and the next app spins into the middle, fast, and the ring never ends. The name of the selected app sits big on the right.
